nodes.raw_latex:
\label{Perfectoid Field}
    
    

    Let $K$ be a topological field. We say that $K$ is a \emph{perfectoid field} if and only if the following conditions are satisfied:\\
    (a) the topology on K is induced by a valuation $\| \cdot \| : K \to \R_{\ge0}$, and $K$ is complete for this topology;\\
    (b) there exists a non-unit $\pi \in \O_K$ such that $p \in \pi^p \O_K$;\\
    (c) every element of $\O_K/p\O_K$ is a $p$th-power.
nodes.clean_text: Let K be a topological field. We say that K is a perfectoid field if and only if the following conditions are satisfied:\\ (a) the topology on K is induced by a valuation \| cdot \| : K to R_ge0, and K is complete for this topology;\\ (b) there exists a non-unit pi in O_K such that p in pi^p O_K;\\ (c) every element of O_K/pO_K is a pth-power.
nodes.label: Perfectoid Field
